title: Reject unreadable escalation timestamps before planning another attempt
prompt:
Fix the pure escalation planner bypassing its minimum retry interval when an attempt timestamp is invalid. Change only lib/ohworks-critical-notification-escalation.ts and add tests/ohworks-escalation-invalid-time.test.ts. Evidence: lib/ohworks-critical-notification-escalation.ts:111-119 stores an unchecked Date.parse result and compares elapsed minutes without checking finiteness; lines 131-135 then return contact_now. Reproduced with one synthetic ordering-provider contact, one unreached attempt at attemptedAt=invalid, maxAttemptsPerContact=3, a valid now, and minMinutesBetweenAttemptsToSameContact=15: the planner returns contact_now rather than rejecting the unusable timing evidence. The critical-results demo displays this planner's next-action advice.

Validate the parsed current time and attempt timestamps before computing an unacknowledged escalation plan. Throw a deterministic RangeError with a fixed, privacy-safe message for non-finite parsed timestamps; do not echo contact details or raw inputs. Preserve the existing already-acknowledged short circuit, chain ordering, attempt exhaustion rules, and exact retry boundary. Keep this bounded to unreadable timestamps; do not change notification delivery or introduce any send operation.

Test invalid now, invalid first and later attempt timestamps, unsorted valid attempts, and just-before/exact retry boundaries. Assert malformed timing cannot yield a contact_now plan and valid plans remain unchanged. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks-escalation-invalid-time.test.ts. Planner reproduction confirmed the defect; 140 focused existing tests passed. Open and recently merged PR diffs showed no overlap. work on the assigned branch you are on. Change only the two named files; no credentials, sends, or external operations.
